1479-1659-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1659-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3534-7084-8249.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
3534-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.
3534-7084-8249.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

225-1021-1669-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2586-3197-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat

413-1339-1940.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-1339-1940.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

710-728-1258.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

240-5470-7296-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

3525-4474-7938.description:
Activate Shuttle Ace by tapping it, adding {U}.
Shuttle Ace triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Shuttle Ace.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without summoning sickness

225-880-7892.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You control a mana-producing land.
225-880-7892.description:
Activate a mana-producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a mana-producing land.
Repeat.

1651-5469-7824.description:
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating two Clue, Food or Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.

1987-5913-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-5913-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-5913-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4875-5010-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Golgari Thug's power, which will cause you to mill Golgari Thug.
As Golgari Thug is a Lhurgoyf due to Conspiracy, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Golgari Thug from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2511-5170-6094-6132.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1718-3327-4613-7096.easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
1718-3327-4613-7096.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-3327-4613-7096.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

57-4846-4885-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-4846-4885-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-2866-4211-4986.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4050-4871-6476-6927.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4050-4871-6476-6927.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Damage Control Crew and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Damage Control Crew enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Damage Control Crew, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

985-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2781-2947-5231.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Vesperlark.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-3497-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2292-3497-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
2292-3497-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2292-3497-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

4974-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
4974-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
4974-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

4826-5222-5256-6644.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that are untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

1494-6599.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Maester Seymour triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1274-3188-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3188-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Legendary Artifact Creature with no colored cost

661-2034-3003-3169--50.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast your commander by paying {0} due to Mycosynth Golem.
661-2034-3003-3169--50.description:
Cast your commander by paying {0} due to Mycosynth Golem.
When your commander enters the battlefield, Sculpting Steel and Genesis Chamber trigger, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing your commander, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return your commander to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

184-851-3883.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
184-851-3883.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create two Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

2639-4050-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Mitotic Slime to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mitotic Slime, adding {B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the two Ooze tokens, adding {2}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Ooze tokens, adding {2}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate any of Kenrtih's other abilities.

1039-1116-3358.notablePrerequisites:
Hell's Caretaker does not have summoning sickness.
It is your upkeep step.
1039-1116-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Hell's Caretaker.
When Teardrop Kami dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping it and sacrificing the Graveborn, returning Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

659-2816-4050.easyPrerequisites:
Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Krenko.
659-2816-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
659-2816-4050.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Goblin tokens, adding {3}.
Activate Krenko by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

225-539-618.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Stone-Seeder Hierophant with haste.
Activate the Stone-Seeder Hierophant token by tapping it, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

2561-2835-4694-4853.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
 The Underworld Cookbook does not have summoning sickness.
2561-2835-4694-4853.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding a card, creating a Food artifact token.
The Food enters the battlefield as a 0/0 artifact creature and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Dross Scorpion and Fecundity triggers.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

628-3240-3757-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
Nether Traitor dies, triggering Mikaeus, returning Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding one mana of any color.
Nether Traitor dies, triggering Felisa, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Inkling, adding one mana of any color.
The Inkling dies, triggering Nether Traitor, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1472-2232-2530-3265-5093.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least four.
1472-2232-2530-3265-5093.description:
Cast Dockside Chef by paying {B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
Keimi enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Carnival of Souls.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Dockside Chef enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Carnival of Souls.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Gnarled Scarhide from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Cast Gnarled Scarhide by paying {B}.
Keimi triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Gnarled Scarhide enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Carnival of Souls.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Dockside Chef from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Cast Dockside Chef by paying {B}.
Keimi triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 6.

1409-1621-4344.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Lumbering Battlement.
1409-1621-4344.description:
Activate Lumbering Battlement by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield.
Wispweaver Angel and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering Wispweaver Angel's ability, Lumbering Battlement's ability, and Deadeye Navigator's ability twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, choosing not to pair.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.
